hooks.command: cmd="$(jq -r ".tool_input.command")"; branch="$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null)"; if [ "$branch" = "main" ] && printf "%s\n" "$cmd" | grep -qE "(^|[;&|]|&&|\\|\\|)[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]+(commit|push)([[:space:]]|$)"; then jq -n --arg reason "Blocked: git commit/push directly on main. Create a feature branch first (see CLAUDE.md workflow / /feature-branch skill)." "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PreToolUse\",permissionDecision:\"deny\",permissionDecisionReason:\$reason}}"; fi
